theme_fields.name: yaml
theme_fields.value:
links:
  type: objects
  default:
    - name: Home
      url: /latest
  schema:
    name: link
    properties:
      name:
        type: string
        required: true
      url:
        type: string
      weight:
        type: integer
      ratio:
        type: float
      flag:
        type: boolean
      children:
        type: objects
        schema:
          name: child
          properties:
            label:
              type: string
              required: true
empty_links:
  type: objects
  default: []
  schema:
    name: link
    properties:
      name:
        type: string
